independent_boundary_and_surface_flux_au.scope: Independent mesh-only boundary connectivity and oriented surface-flux volume/COM audit

limitations: Only thickness-direction volume discretization varies on the original fixed polyhedral shell; all sampled boundary tractions and frozen physical inputs are checked. Raw global corner peaks and work identities are independently reconstructed. Equilibrium budgets are recorded from the independently assembled FEM driver, not reassembled here. A thickness tail does not establish CAD/surface/contact convergence, native accuracy, deformable-contact feedback or the full Franka application. All original gates remain.
